as_told.title: Mentor in Princeton PEAR random event generator experiments

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a close friend and mentor of his worked at a lab at Princeton University, which he calls the PEAR lab, that studied all sorts of unexplained things. There, according to Michels, his mentor ran experiments with machines that produce random results, and described something he called the rebound effect. Michels mentions it as a sign that the mind might affect such machines in odd ways.
